text: Viel zu simpel, keine Intervalle, ausschließlich daily habits, aber schöner Look.
author: Maik Lindner

text: Gelungene Gestaltung und Bedienung. Leider scheint die Anwendung gelegentlich zu vergessen, dass eine Eintragung vorgenommen wurde, jetzt ist mir schon zum wiederholten Male eine Reihe beendet worden, weil ich angeblich keine Eintragung vorgenommen habe. Hab ich aber. So leider sinnbefreit.
author: Jens

text: Anfangs funktionierte die Erinnerung, dann plötzlich nicht mehr
author: Jasmin B

text: Very nice designed and free app. I like the app and its simple usage. However, I have some requests and ideas for funktions for updates in the future: changing color theme, a calender where you see when you did which habit and a function where you, when you filled out one habit by accident, can reverse this action :)
author: Katharina Hruby

text: Awesome concept. Well programmed. Feature request: ability to edit alert times of individual habits.
author: Jakob Schmitt

text: The app has a great design and is very minimalistic. However, although it is possible to set a reminder every day, the reminder does not work for me. In addition, I cannot change the time of the reminder. Unfortunately it is currently not possible to change the "check" for the habit afterwards if you've forgotten to do this the day before.
author: Felicitas Koch

text: nice and minimal. would be great to see the exact dates when the habit was done. Thanks!
author: Lena Teresa
developer_reply: Lena, thanks for your feedback! This functionality is currently being developed. Wait for the update :)
